build: Steam store page read 2026-10-15 (PC 2021-03-04; Switch 2021-12; Xbox 2023-04; iOS/Android 2024-04-30)

package.basis: Desk only, not played: Steam store page and review API (English, ~17.4k reviews, 91% positive; 359 reviews sampled), Wikipedia reception, mobile launch coverage, and this repo's prior competitor research.

learn.practice: Sell the pitch in one image: the player authors the world the hero auto-walks, and every screenshot shows both the hero and the player's choices on one board. An auto-played dungeon should show the configured stance/tactic acting on screen, not only in a menu.
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/1282730?json=1&filter=all&language=english&num_per_page=100 [rec 225111707] an auto-battler where you build the world around your hero using cards

learn.practice: Graded exit stakes (100% at camp, 60% retreat, 30% death) make every leave decision legible; but players resent the death cut as grind, so keep losses in time, not wealth, unless the player chose the stake.
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/1282730?json=1&filter=all&language=english&num_per_page=100 [rec 228522036] they won't give you the full resources for losing

learn.practice: Explain interactions in place; Loop Hero's biggest onboarding complaint is having to google mechanics. Put a codex entry one tap from the thing itself.
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/1282730?json=1&filter=all&language=english&num_per_page=100 [rec 227992603] I have to keep googling mechanics because they're not explained in-game

learn.practice: A memorable soundtrack carries long passive sessions; even negative reviews cite it.
learn.evidence: https://store.steampowered.com/appreviews/1282730?json=1&filter=all&language=english&num_per_page=100 [rec 218364520] the music is quite memorable and yet the crushing grind is unbearable
